response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg
